name: parentSysId
label: Parent Sys ID
description: The Sys ID of the parent record containing the playbook

name: parentTable
label: Parent table
description: The table of the parent record containing the playbook

name: playbookExperienceId
label: Playbook experience ID
description: The playbook experience that the playbook should use

name: compactMode
label: Compact mode
description: Display this playbook in compact mode for smaller UIs

name: isNewParentRecord
label: Is new parent record
description: Specify that the parent record is new

name: recordGeneratorQuery
label: Query
description: Encoded query string to optionally override the query provided for a record generator

name: activityView
label: Activity view
description: The activity view determines how activities are displayed in the playbook. Stacked shows all activities for a lane in the work area. Focused shows all activities for a lane in the playbook navigation and one activity at a time in the work area

name: enableFullWidthCards
label: Enable full-width cards
description: Allow all cards in the playbook to take up the full page width
